Free bindings z, manualModelConfigSchema, modelConfigDataSchema, type ManualModelConfig already supplied by retained preamble/public declaration. No field lists hardcoded in owner. extractManualModelConfig(input:unknown):ManualModelConfig returns exactly manualModelConfigSchema.parse(projectedInput). Native member-call callee parse is resolved BEFORE recursive argument projection; keep receiver/schema call and native errors, no separate safeParse/default/fallback/wrapping. Pick helper has schema parameter z.ZodObject and input unknown, returns unknown. For any falsy input, nonobject input, or Array input, immediately return SAME input unchanged, no recursion/schema inspection. Otherwise treat object as Record<string,unknown>, enumerate Object.entries(schema.shape) ONCE/eagerly (native schema insertion order/enumerable own string keys), then visit pairs in that order. For each, test key in source (includes inherited properties and Proxy has behavior, not own-only). Absent key emits nothing; present undefined emits own key undefined. For each present key, read source[key] once; if child instanceof z.ZodObject recurse with child and same value, otherwise preserve the exact value reference. Child subclass is object; wrapped nullable/optional/effects schema remains a leaf unless actual instanceof object. Produce fresh ordinary plain Object.fromEntries of projected [key,value] pairs. No source enumeration/read of unselected fields, no symbol keys, no sorting/dedup/merging/defaults/coercion. Root schema and child entries obtained before corresponding source getter reads by normal Object.entries behavior. Retained parser validates strict/manual field presence/types/order and makes its usual output clone; helper must not pretend invalid leaf is valid. Missing optional enabled allowed; all other picked required branches stay required.

clearManualModelConfig(input:z.infer<typeof modelConfigDataSchema>) preserves original inferred returned canonical model schema output (do not introduce differently serialized public alias). Return modelConfigDataSchema.parse(remainingInput) after removing schema-owned manual leaves EXCEPT enabled. Native callee parse read before evaluating manualModelConfigSchema.omit({enabled:true}) and recursive remaining-input argument. Each call uses manualModelConfigSchema.omit({enabled:true}) freshly and passes result as traversal schema; enabled stays data, not dropped. No parse repair/expansion/schema mutation. Native parser/factory/getter/proxy/iterator failures propagate SAME object without catching/wrapping and preserve ordering.

Omit helper schema z.ZodObject/input unknown→unknown: same immediate identity return for falsy/nonobject/Array inputs. Otherwise eagerly Object.entries(input) reads enumerable OWN string-key source values in source insertion order before any schema.shape lookup/recursive work. Symbols and inherited source fields do not enter result. Visit each [key,value] in input order: child=schema.shape[key] native bracket lookup (truthiness, includes inherited lookup if shape has it). If child falsy/absent, keep [key,value] EXACT ref. If child is not instanceof z.ZodObject OR value==null (both undefined/null), drop this owned key. For an object child and non-null value, recursively omit using SAME child/value. Keep [key,remaining] ONLY when remaining truthy && typeof remaining=="object" && Object.keys(remaining).length>0; otherwise drop key, pruning empty manual-owned containers. No Array exclusion in this final remainder check: nested nonempty array passes as remainder then retained parser can reject, while empty array/falsy/primitive remainder is pruned. No new required-type rejection before parser. System leaf branches whose keys aren't in manual tree stay exact before canonical parse (including schema-defined hidden fields); unknown foreign fields also stay, so canonical strict validation/error order remains authoritative. Produce fresh ordinary Object.fromEntries of kept pairs, preserving original input key order for retained entries. Top-level function then canonical sparse schema parse clones/validates as normal. Do not mutate/freeze original input or editable/system schema; no recursive permission inference, denylist allowlist recreation, JSON stringify, Object.hasOwn substitution, optional schema unwrapping, deep clones, default creation or catch.

Frozen schema permissions context (retain existing expression): optional/nullable enabled; properties editable contextWindow, supportsJsonSchemaOutput, supportsNativeWebSearch, supportsMidConversationSystem; inputFormat editable supportsImage/supportsVideo/supportsPdf. System-only requiresMfjsToolSchema/supportsToolCall/inputFormat.supportsText/supportsAudio/outputFormat preserved by clear, never extracted as editable. optionSpecs.reasoningLevel values/map both editable; optionSpecs.maxOutputTokens.max editable, map system-only. This list is EXTERNAL CONTRACT ONLY, never duplicate in reconstructed functions. canonical types and strict model schema ports retained. Key/error order and special ordinary object assignment/entry behavior unchanged. Fixed schema/type/imports/wrappers/literals/dependency expression not originality claim. Whole recursive tree owner selected, not renamed/extracted source by coordinator.
